blocks.text: SHENZHEN, China – Russia’s strategic priority is to develop constructive partnership with the economies of the Asia-Pacific region, Russian President Vladimir Putin said at the plenary session of the APEC summit. “I would like to emphasize that a constructive partnership with the economies of the Asia Pacific region is Russia’s strategic course. We are an integral part of the region and contribute much to its economic prosperity,” he said.
